data.long_meaning: Bahram is a Persian name that signifies victory and triumph. It is a popular name in Islamic tradition, symbolizing success and achievement. The name Bahram carries the meaning “Victorious, Triumphant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bahram usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, triumphant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Bahram is associated with the concept of 'falah' or success, which is mentioned in the Quran as a blessing from Allah.
data.etymology: Bahram belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Triumphant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bahram total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: بهرام
in_arabic.long_meaning: بهرام هو اسم فارسي الأصل يُستخدم في الثقافة الإسلامية ويتميز بالنجاح والفوز والقوة والشجاعة، وله أصول في اللغة الفارسية القديمة ويرتبط بالأساطير الفارسية والتراث الإسلامي

in_urdu.name: بہرام
in_urdu.long_meaning: بہرام ایک فارسی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں استعمال ہوتا ہے اور کامیابی، فتح، قوت، اور بہادری کے لیے مشہور ہے، اور اس کی جڑیں پرانے فارسی زبان اور اسلامی روایات میں ہیں

in_hindi.name: बह्राम

in_pashto.name: بهرام

The name's association with Iranian heritage has influenced the cultural perception of Bahram as a symbol of pride and strength for many individuals, particularly those of Iranian or Persian descent.
